name: SH2 Cast - Right (aimed)
description: MSCO_right1-4 on the neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget AIMED cast the fork resolved to the RIGHT hand. SpellHotbar_SpellAnimationType (0x815) == 1 is cast_anim_ids.h kAimed.primary; SpellHotbar_CastingSource (0x835) == 1 is RE::MagicSystem::CastingSource::kRightHand. Each clip carries MSCO's own MRh_SpellFire_Event, which is the armed hand's commitment point for this cell.
